title: Signoff: LaunchProcess addendum (11-sandbox-host-service.add03)
description:
Verify docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add03.md against actual implementation.

Code packages to compare against:
- internal/rpc/api/types.go (LaunchProcess/KillProcess/GetProcessStatus types)
- internal/rpc/codec/sandbox_map.go (process management codec mappings)
- internal/rpc/server/sandbox_server.go (process management RPC handlers)
- internal/rpc/transport/server.go (new procedure registration)
- internal/sandbox/service.go (ManagedProcess, process lifecycle, port proxying, PID tracking)

Instructions:
1. Read add03 thoroughly — checklist of every RPC type, handler, lifecycle state,
   port proxy behavior, process monitoring, error handling path
2. Compare each against actual code
3. Classify deviations: Cosmetic, Structural, Contractual, or Missing
4. Run: go test ./internal/sandbox/... ./internal/rpc/... -count=1
5. Run with race detector: go test -race ./internal/sandbox/... ./internal/rpc/... -count=1
6. Determine status per deviation severity rules
7. Append Completion Signoff section to the doc
8. Commit and push, report back via h2 send
